svg.text: DeepSeek-V4.1 ROM array: layer die floorplan (analytical, 31.8 x 25.63 mm = 815 mm2)
Areas from the ledger (ASAP7 cell area / 0.70 utilisation, N5 ROM density, published UCIe-A module, assumed HBM/SerDes PHY). tools/v41_die_assembly.py
Package peer (UCIe) to the right; package outer edge (board SerDes) to the left; HBM3E stacks above and below.
112G SerDes (TP 26 + stage 14 + switch 2 + spare 3 per die)
vector unit + HC projection + sequencer/select spine
1. spine to farthest tile (matvec in/out): 23.2 mm, 20 / 5
3. spine to SerDes (stage hop, pair collective): 14.9 mm, 13 / 4
4. HBM PHY to tiles (KV / index keys): 16.1 mm, 14 / 4
Tiles: 48 (ROM | lane column | ROM), 3.24 x 3.99 mm; weights stay in their tile. Overhead (PLL, PDN, DFT) and whitespace are spread through the tiles and channels.
Analytical floorplan, not a routed die. ASAP7 block areas are not N5 areas (docs/ROM_DENSITY_NODE_TRANSFER.md s11).
